board-about: Everyone's first Daily challenge run of the day, best score first. Faster reading breaks a tie.
board-empty: No one is on this board yet.
board-empty-friends: None of your friends is on this board yet.
board-friends-off: Friends are people you follow who follow you back. You see them here while you share your own progress with friends.
board-me-checks: This run is not on the board: it did not pass the board's timing checks.
board-me-hidden: A moderator took this run off the board.
board-me-no-start: This run is not on the board: the start of this run did not reach us.
board-me-not-played: You haven't played today's challenge yet.
board-me-private: Your {{score}} would place {{rank}} of {{total}}. Only you can see this.
board-me-started: Your run started but didn't finish, so this day has no score.
board-next: The board starts again at {{time}} your time.
chord-hint-screen: Tap {{notes}} together: use several fingers, or tap quickly.
chord-mic: The microphone hears one note at a time, so it cannot hear a chord.
chord-too-few: That was only part of it. Play {{notes}} together.
credits-intro: The lessons play recordings of real instruments. These are their makers and licences.
ear-sound-asleep: Sound isn't playing. Tap to turn it on.
ear-sound-failed: Sound still isn't playing. Tap to try again.
error-save: Couldn't save that change. Try again.
error-signed-out: Your session ended. Sign in again to continue.
find-fretboard-help: Arrow keys move between strings and frets. Enter or Space answers with that place.
find-group-a: A sits between the last two of the three black keys.
find-group-b: B is just right of the three black keys.
find-group-c: C is just left of the two black keys.
find-group-d: D sits between the two black keys.
find-group-e: E is just right of the two black keys.
find-group-f: F is just left of the three black keys.
find-group-g: G sits between the first two of the three black keys.
find-hint-guitar-play: Find it on the fretboard, or play it.
find-hint-open: The open strings are the column left of the nut.
find-hint-piano: Find that key on the piano below.
find-hint-piano-play: Find that key, or play it.
find-keys-line: Keys A to K on your computer play C4 to C5.
find-staff-guitar: {{note}}, written as {{written}} on the treble staff
find-start-failed: Couldn't start it. Change input shows why.
first-note-hint-keys: Press A, S, D, F, G, H, J or K on your computer keyboard. A is C4.
first-note-hint-mic: Play one note on your instrument, or sing one, near the microphone.
first-note-hint-midi: Press any key on your MIDI controller.
first-note-hint-screen: Tap any key on the piano below.
flash-card-ask-bass: A note on the bass staff
flash-card-ask-treble: A note on the treble staff
flash-hint-keys: Tap its letter, or play it on your computer keys.
flash-hint-mic: Tap its letter, or play or sing it.
flash-hint-midi: Tap its letter, or play it on your MIDI controller.
flash-hint-screen: Tap its letter, or play it on the piano below.
flash-keys-region: Your computer keys are a piano: A, S, D, F, G, H, J and K play C, D, E, F, G, A, B and C.
input-keys-desc: Keys A to K play C4 to C5. W, E, T, Y and U are the black keys.
input-mic-desc: For guitar or voice. Works best in a quiet room.
input-midi-desc: The most accurate way to play: a digital piano or keyboard over USB or Bluetooth.
input-screen-desc: Tap the piano on your screen. Always works.
latency-hint-keys: Press A on your keyboard on each click.
latency-hint-mic: Play or sing a short note on each click.
latency-hint-midi: Press a key on your controller on each click.
latency-hint-screen: Tap the pad on each click.
latency-intro: You will hear 8 clicks. Play along with each one. This tells lessons how much delay your setup adds.
latency-no-audio: Sound can't play in this browser, so timing can't be checked.
latency-result: Done. Your setup adds about {{ms}} ms. Lessons will allow for it.
latency-retry: We didn't catch enough taps. Try again and play on every click.
lesson-save-failed: Couldn't save your progress. Check your connection and try again.
lesson-unavailable-body: This lesson isn't ready yet. Pick another one from your learning path.
match-hint-screen: Play the note you see on the keys below.
match-out: Out of tries: hear it, then go on.
match-out-close: Out of tries, but your best was close.
match-sound-blocked: Sound didn't start. Tap Hear it again.
match-try-flat-one: Quite flat: bring it up. One try left.
match-try-flat-two: Quite flat: bring it up. Two tries left.
match-try-little-flat-one: Close: a little flat. One try left.
match-try-little-flat-two: Close: a little flat. Two tries left.
match-try-little-sharp-one: Close: a little sharp. One try left.
match-try-little-sharp-two: Close: a little sharp. Two tries left.
match-try-octave-one: Wrong octave: that was {{note}}. One try left.
match-try-octave-two: Wrong octave: that was {{note}}. Two tries left.
match-try-sharp-one: Quite sharp: bring it down. One try left.
match-try-sharp-two: Quite sharp: bring it down. Two tries left.
match-try-wrong-one: Not quite: that was {{note}}. One try left.
match-try-wrong-two: Not quite: that was {{note}}. Two tries left.
mic-audio-failed: Sound couldn't start on this device. Reload the page and try again.
mic-blocked: Microphone access was blocked. To allow it, tap the lock or settings icon next to the address bar, turn on the microphone for this site, then try again.
mic-failed: The microphone couldn't start. Another app may be using it. Close it and try again.
mic-listening: Listening… play or sing a note.
mic-not-found: No microphone was found. Connect one, or check that it is turned on.
mic-unsupported: This browser can't use a microphone on this page.
midi-blocked: MIDI access was blocked. Allow MIDI devices for this site in your browser settings, then try again.
midi-failed: MIDI couldn't start in this browser.
midi-no-device: Plug in or pair a MIDI controller. It will show up here.
midi-try: Play a key: it lights up here.
midi-unsupported-hint: iPhone and iPad browsers cannot use MIDI. Use the on-screen keys or the microphone, or open this page in Chrome or Edge on a computer.
practice-nothing-due: Nothing to practise right now. Come back when a card is due.
rhythm-meter-hint: Listen for the accent, then pick how many beats are in each bar.
rhythm-tap-hint-keyboard: Tap the pad or press a piano key (A to K) on every beat.
rhythm-tap-hint-keys: Tap the pad, press the space bar or a piano key (A to K) on every beat.
rhythm-tap-hint-mic: The microphone isn't used for rhythm. Tap the pad on every beat.
rhythm-tap-hint-midi: Press a key on your controller on every beat.
rhythm-tap-hint-screen: Tap the pad on every beat.
rhythm-tap-intro: Four clicks count you in. Then tap along for 16 beats.
rhythm-tap-lost: Sound stopped, so this run was dropped. Start again.
rhythm-tap-no-sound: Sound isn't playing. Start to try again.
rhythm-tap-result: {{hits}} of {{total}} beats on time. {{early}} early, {{late}} late.
rhythm-values-hint: How many beats does the underlined note last?
sing-interval-hear-first: Tap Hear it for the first note, then sing.
sing-interval-other: Hear it, then sing the second note above {{note}}.
social-board-help: Signed-in learners see your name, picture and score. Off hides every day at once.
social-board-label: Show my Daily challenge scores on the board
song-intro-play: One bar of clicks counts you in. Then play along in time.
song-intro-wait: Play each note when you are ready. The cursor waits for you.
song-keys-black: For sharps: W, E, T, Y and U play C♯, D♯, F♯, G♯ and A♯.
song-locked: Stop the run to change how you play or your input.
song-mic-repeat: Stop the string or take a breath between repeated notes.
song-missing: This song isn't in the songbook.
song-moved-key: Moved to {{name}} major for your voice.
song-score-label: The score of {{title}}: {{bars}} bars, {{beats}} beats to a bar.
song-stopped-away: You left the page, so this run was dropped. Start again.
song-stopped-dialog: The run stopped while the settings were open. Start again.
song-stopped-sound: Sound stopped, so this run was dropped. Start again.
song-wait-guitar-octave: Guitar sounds an octave below the staff: play the {{note}} one octave lower.
song-wait-octave: That {{note}} is in another octave. Play the one written.
songs-intro: Read a melody from its score and play it: the cursor can wait for you, or keep time.
songs-row-best-both: Wait for me: best {{wait}}. Play along: best {{play}}.
sound-cello-detail: A cello section. Single notes and intervals.
sound-fallback-tone: Couldn't load the {{instrument}} sound. Playing a simple tone.
sound-load-failed: Couldn't load this sound. Lessons will play a simple tone.
sound-organ-detail: A quiet pipe organ stop. Plays chords.
sound-save-failed: Couldn't save your sound. Pick it again.

sprint-label-bar-treble: {{notes}} in order on the treble staff
